event: Bank Indonesia held the BI-Rate at 5.75% at its October RDG but raised the Deposit Facility rate to 5%, citing rupiah pressure, global uncertainty and tight US monetary policy. (update of E0167)
key_numbers: BI-Rate 5.75% (hold) · Deposit Facility 5.00% (+25 bp) · Lending Facility 6.50% unchanged · Sept inflation 3.28% y/y (core 2.88%, volatile food 5.03%) · bank credit +13.21% y/y (investment credit +23.2%) · 2026 growth range 4.9-5.7%

event: The rupiah weakened past Rp18,000 per US dollar after Bank Indonesia held its policy rate. (update of E0172)
key_numbers: Reported closes Rp18,022 and Rp18,060 per USD (outlets differ) · morning level Rp18,083 · 20 Oct close Rp17,995 (E0172)

event: OJK and Bareskrim detailed sanctions totalling Rp2.1 trillion in the DSSA, BREN and CUAN share cases, fining a market-manipulation customer and entities that hid the identities of share buyers. (update of E0053)
key_numbers: DSSA: PT SMT fined Rp1.5 T, nine brokers fined, one licence suspended 1 year · BREN: AH Ltd fined Rp500 B · CUAN: TC Pte Ltd fined Rp100 B, two brokers fined, one licence suspended 3 months · total Rp2.1 T

event: President Prabowo said Indonesia is not afraid of MSCI, and OJK's chief responded, as Airlangga called the market tremors not disruptive and MSCI's timeline runs to a June 2027 final decision.
key_numbers: MSCI consultation until Apr 2027 · final decision by 30 Jun 2027 · IHSG 21 Oct close 5,328

event: Manpower Minister Yassierli said the 2027 minimum wage formula will follow the new labour law and no percentage is set, while unions propose a 7.5-9.5% rise.
key_numbers: Union proposal 7.5-9.5% · union formula (inflation 3.20% + growth 5.43%) x index 0.9 = about 7.8% (our calc) · PP 49/2025 index 0.5-0.9 · new labour law passed by DPR 6 Oct · union protests 15-30 Oct in 38 provinces · wage setting reported scheduled around 1 Nov

event: Coordinating Minister Airlangga said the government has prepared about Rp31.8 trillion for a wage subsidy (BSU), rice aid and a Christmas-New Year transport discount running through end-2026.
key_numbers: Total Rp31.8 T · rice aid 10 kg per recipient (reported as 10 kg for 3 months, extended to year-end) · per-programme amounts and eligibility not stated

event: Energy Minister Bahlil said the government is considering not extending gas exports to neighbouring countries so domestic needs come first, following Prabowo's 'survival mode' call at a cabinet plenary.
key_numbers: Volumes, destinations and contract dates not stated · described as an option, not a decision

event: The government reiterated that Pertalite will not rise in price despite surging oil prices, after Deputy Energy Minister Yuliot said subsidised fuel prices are held through year-end. (update of E0094)
key_numbers: Oil about US$107 per barrel (end-Sep, US-Iran tension) · Brent about US$108-110 mid-Oct (E0127, E0174) · Pertalite and Biosolar price unchanged to end-2026 · Pertalite stock 16-18 days (E0128)

event: BBNI is scheduled to report Q3 2026 results on 23 October, with BMRI 27 Oct, BRIS 29 Oct and BBRI/BBTN/BDMN 30 Oct to follow amid the market sell-off. (update of E0150)
key_numbers: BBNI 23 Oct · BMRI 27 Oct · BRIS 29 Oct · BBRI, BBTN, BDMN 30 Oct · Fed meeting 28 Oct

event: Prabowo, at a plenary cabinet meeting on 21 Oct and again at the TPAKD national meeting on 22 Oct, says foreign companies holding concessions are suspected of contributing to karhutla, orders permits of proven violators revoked, and says company names will be announced 'pada saatnya'.
key_numbers: 32 companies under forestry administrative sanctions (Forestry Minister Raja Juli Antoni, 21 Oct) · 6 Kalimantan firms newly suspended, largest burned area PT Hasil Kalimantan Jaya 4,803 ha of 36,745 ha concession · Prabowo: one firm violated 'up to 19 times', permits should go after 2 violations · no company named

event: Luhut's proposal to drop state loss from the definition of corruption draws more pushback: PKS legislators Nasir Djamil and Mardani Ali Sera (DPR Komisi III) oppose it, a Golkar-linked DPR member and a PUKAT UGM researcher weigh in, while Yusril calls it worth considering; no direct Palace statement yet.
key_numbers: Nasir Djamil: 'ahistoris dan layak ditolak' · Soedeson Tandra (ANTARA headline): state loss must stay in the definition · PUKAT UGM: adopt UNCAC offences into UU Tipikor · Luhut's claim of Prabowo approval still unconfirmed by Palace

event: KPK detains 7 of 8 suspects in the expanded North Sumatra road-project corruption case, including former BBPJN Sumut head Stanley Cicero Haggard Tuapattinaja; the eighth, Dicky Erlangga, skipped the summons and is called again on 26 Oct.
key_numbers: 7 detained for 20 days, 22 Oct–10 Nov · 8 suspects · 6 projects worth about Rp231.8 miliar · OTT 26 Jun 2025 · KPK says it may extend to North Sumatra provincial government and Ministry of PU parties

event: TNI says it will follow up KPK's 20 Oct letter to Panglima Agus Subiyanto naming two active soldiers allegedly involved in the BNPB disaster-fund corruption case; KPK is awaiting TNI's reply. (update of E0215)
key_numbers: 2 active soldiers · KPK letter 20 Oct · 5 civilian suspects named 14 Oct · KPK seizures Rp5.47 miliar (16 Oct) · Puspom TNI informed about ex-BNPB head Suharyanto's role

event: GRIB Jaya says, via lawyer Wilson Colling, that the Rp800 juta Hercules handed to KPK came from PT Summarecon Agung for a 65-ha land dispute in Bogor; KPK says it is tied to the alleged bribery over Summarecon's HGB at ATR/BPN. (update of E0209)

event: Madiun mayor (non-active) Maidi is sentenced to 5 years by the Surabaya Tipikor court in the CSR-extortion and project-fee case, 2 years 2 months below KPK's demand.
key_numbers: 5 years · fine Rp250 juta (3 months substitute) · demand 7 years 2 months · KPK demanded replacement money Rp8,005,384,790 (court order on it not confirmed)

event: 40 national figures file an amicus curiae at the Jakarta Tipikor court asking for acquittal of former Ombudsman chair Hery Susanto during the defence rejoinder; verdict is set for 5 Nov.
key_numbers: Alleged bribes Rp4.85 miliar · demand 5 years 6 months + Rp300 juta fine + Rp4.19 miliar restitution · 40 amicus filers · verdict 5 Nov 2026

event: East Java police arrest 11 people accused of trying to provoke unrest at the student rally at Gedung Grahadi, Surabaya, which the police chief calls largely peaceful. (update of E0179)
key_numbers: 11 arrested (2 students, 9 school dropouts) · thinner, arak, knuckle-dusters, phones seized · Polda Jatim chief Irjen Dekananto Eko Purwono

key_numbers: Musda 23 Oct 2026 · Munafri resigned from Golkar 5 Oct

event: PHP Foundation releases security fixes for two critical 'php2shell' flaws in the PHP core, found with AI by Wiz and Calif researchers, after details leaked; exploitation attempts reportedly climbed to millions and agencies in several countries issued warnings.
